name: Sequential 2D/1D Transfer Function Combination
definition: A method that sequentially applies a 2D transfer function and a 1D transfer function to all voxels of a multivariate volume dataset to improve feature classification specificity, addressing the difficulty of robustly separating features using only single 1D or 2D transfer functions.
summary: Sequential 2D/1D Transfer Function Combination improves feature classification by applying 2D and 1D transfer functions sequentially, avoiding misclassification pitfalls of high-dimensional products.
